capabilities: Arrange note relationships around a Compass
Navigate notes by parent, child, friend and challenger roles
Create and edit relationship properties from the canvas
Filter and style the graph with Graph Lenses
Open a companion sidecar editor beside the graph
disambiguation: Not a media-server client; it is a visual navigator for note relationships.
extras: New plugin still undergoing real-world testing; README warns to test on a small set of notes and keep backups. Optional ExcaliBrain settings import and Excalidraw note creation.
intentEvidence: If classic ExcaliBrain is installed and running, K-Plex can import its ontology and graph, node and link styling.
motivation: Large graph views can quickly become dense and hard to navigate, so the author built a structured neighborhood around the current note.
problem: Large Obsidian graph views become dense and hard to navigate, and link types are treated mainly as styling rather than meaningful spatial relationships.

relations.evidence: If classic ExcaliBrain is installed and running, K-Plex can import its ontology and graph, node and link styling.
optional Excalidraw note creation when Excalidraw is installed
supported Templater code are processed before relationship properties are written

summary: Ontology-driven visual navigator that arranges a note’s relationships around a Compass and lets you explore, filter and edit them.
